prose: TikTok launched a conversational Shopping Assistant that remembers preferences and answers product, shipping, sizing and availability questions, plus a Buy Direct checkout that lets users purchase from brands in one click from the For You feed. TechCrunch's reading is that TikTok wants to keep the whole shopping journey, and more transaction value, inside the app instead of sending users to outside AI tools.
highlights: Shopping Assistant remembers context and preferences.
Buy Direct: one-click checkout from the For You feed.
Aim: keep shopping and spend inside TikTok.
